vectors.name: get_info_request
vectors.description: Get Info request: MSG_TYPE 0x01 (request, TYPE 0x01) and REQUEST_ID 0001, with an empty body, so the message ends with the REQUEST_ID.

vectors.name: get_info_response_ready
vectors.description: Get Info ok response from a ready signer: vendor "bwk" and model "bwk-signer", firmware 1.2.3 beta, capabilities 0x0000000f (bits 0 to 3), STATE 0x00 (ready), NETWORKS 0x1e (mainnet, testnet, signet and regtest), MAX_MESSAGE 0x00080000 (524288 bytes), MAX_ALIAS 32, MAX_KEYS 16, SLOTS 8, and FINGERPRINT present, deadbeef.

vectors.name: get_info_response_locked
vectors.description: Get Info ok response from a locked signer: the same vendor, model, firmware and capabilities as get_info_response_ready, STATE 0x01 (locked), NETWORKS 0x02 (mainnet only), MAX_MESSAGE 0x00001000 (4096 bytes), MAX_ALIAS 16, MAX_KEYS 5, SLOTS 0 (no storage, proof of registration only), and FINGERPRINT absent as the signer is not ready.
